human_authorisation.authorisation_note: User asked to scope out activating the last remaining candidate registry, exercise_activity_applicability_registry. Research found its source candidate covers only 4 of 19 exercises, only the training context, and the S-V1-23 guard hard-blocks the active file's mere existence - full activation needs new schema fields on all 19 live exercises plus a full 159-record closure, not a data conversion. The repository owner confirmed two derivation rules by explicit decision: (1) an exercise applies to an activity iff its pattern is in that activity's allowed_movement_ids, with back_squat/deadlift/bench_press getting primary_activity_applicability=powerlifting and every other exercise getting general_strength; (2) all 3 required contexts (training/testing/competition) use identical applicability values. Given the size, the work was split into S-REG-32 (this slice: exercise schema/content extension only) and S-REG-33 (the actual exercise_activity_applicability activation and S-V1-23 guard evolution).

rollback_plan.primary: git revert <this-slice-commit> - reverses the extended exercise.registry.json, all 3 exercise schema files, registry_bundle.json, and the seal snapshot hash atomically back to the pre-extension sealed state in one step.
rollback_plan.fallback: If a clean revert is not possible: remove primary_activity_applicability/secondary_activity_applicability from all 19 entries in registries/exercise/exercise.registry.json and from the required/properties lists in ci/schemas/exercise.registry.schema.json, ci/schemas/exercise.registry.schema.v1.0.0.json, and ci/schemas/exercise_registry.schema.json, then run `npm run registry:bundle` and `node ci/scripts/run_registry_seal_freeze.mjs` to confirm the tree returns to a clean sealed state matching the pre-extension snapshot recorded in active_registry_hashes_before.

runtime_parity_proof.note: Unlike every registry activation slice, this extension does not change any registry_index.json order[] entry, so PHASE_3's loaded_registries list (the only thing the two phase3 fixtures are sensitive to) is unaffected. All 13 e2e:golden fixtures were captured before this slice and re-captured after every mutation in this slice; all 13 were byte-identical. This was verified directly, not assumed.
